headline: 1590 works in Karka Bhat each started and finished within one day
reasons: 1590 works in Karka Bhat entered by Collector & District Magistrate each started and ended within a single day.

The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (617), Bench Terracing (598), Tank (303), Bore-Well Recharge (42), Soak Pit (20), Other (9), Gullu Plug (1). Check whether each of these can really be built in one day.
